legend.E: editor state: the claim is the value of an editable field (note title or body) on the cited screen; the edit is shown, its persistence is not
legend.W: weak: the matched text is a generic control label or a bare number that can appear whether or not the obligation was met (a button named Repost, a like count, the word Run)
legend.M: mismatch: the matched text is present but does not evidence the obligation it closes (a component price cited for a cart total; an unrelated screen cited for a skipped branch)
